scope_note: Focused automated runtime acceptance for the named apps on this exact ISO. It does not prove every feature in every app, use of the visible UTM application window, or physical Pi behavior. Live Pi HDMI/headphone audio has prior user confirmation on a separate image; the writable-card candidate still needs physical storage acceptance.
